echo.ultimatemodadditions.boundless.comp: You have achieved what no human before you has accomplished. The §6Mango Engine§f is whole once more, and through it, your reality endures. Now, with the power of creation in your hands, go forth and shape the world to your will.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.boundless.intr: A living, breathing human within the void... how curious.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.boundless.stag: §7It is time to draw upon all that you have learned, human. In this reality, Infinity cannot be understood, only attained.

Knowledgeable though you may be, you are not yet prepared to face that which has no end.

Return once you have completed the §6Chaos§f and §6Radiance§f §3Mango Engine Upgrades§f.
You have arrived at the threshold of Infinity. Beyond this point lies understanding few minds could ever endure.
§bTask Completed!§7 Your Mango Engine now mirrors Infinity, capable of both creation and renewal. The M.A.R.K summons you once more.

You have heard whispers of infinity from the §dEchoes§f, but they grasp only fragments. The §6M.A.R.K's§f simulations can imitate knowledge, yet they cannot comprehend the truth behind it. Infinity is both the beginning and the end, creation and collapse intertwined.
Do not fear what you cannot fully grasp. You need not understand Infinity to wield its power. You need only follow the path I will reveal, for I have walked it countless times.

Begin by compressing matter into distinct singularities, each embodying a separate aspect. Your §6Mango Engine§f will then combine them into a single §aInfinity Singularity§f, the catalyst for creation itself. From it, you may forge the §6Infinity Ingot§f, an alloy that contains the very essence of being.

Once you have gathered nine of these alloys, shape them into a block, and place it alongside two §aReactor Neutron Reflectors§f to shield your §6Mango Engine§f from collapse. Only then will you unlock the final §3Mango Engine Upgrade§f.
§bTask§f: Craft an §6Infinity Block§f and 2 §aReactor Neutron Reflectors§f.
You now hold the spark of creation itself. Use it wisely.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.bugged:
If you're seeing this, there has been a team or progression issue.

Ask a server administrator to check your team's stages with '/ftbteams teamstage <your_username> list'.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.dawn.completed: You have learned well. §6Infinity§f will be waiting for you after you have completed §6Chaos'§f tasks.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.dawn.stage5.ta: §bTask Completed!§7 Your Mango Engine now manipulates void matter with perfect precision. You are closer than ever to stabilizing your realm, human. How remarkable!

Astonishing. I did not expect a human to withstand the collapse of the void. That alone confirms you were chosen. Furthermore, the draconic device in your possession tells me the §6M.A.R.K§f has selected you, which means your purpose aligns with ours, though your lifespan remains far more limited.

My tasks will not be simple. While your §6Mango Engine§f already channels a considerable amount of void energy, no §dEcho§f has studied the void as intimately as I have. My §3Upgrade§f will allow you to fully infuse its unrestrained power into your §6Mango Engine§f. Prolonged exposure to the void's event horizon has enabled me to replicate its properties under controlled conditions.

You must first create a §dBlack Hole§f by accelerating particles with enough force to compress neutrons into a solid state. Using these §aNeutron Piles§f, you can convert Nuclear Waste into a substance that, when supplied with an immense amount of energy, transforms into fluid Antimatter. When solidified §dAntimatter§f and Red Matter collide under sufficient force, a miniature §dBlack Hole§f will form.

Finally, you must contain the §dBlack Hole§f within a vessel made with an §6Awakened Draconic Alloy§f, the only material capable of enduring such raw power. You will also need a solidified Dark Matter base to stabilize it within the §6Mango Engine§f. Once you return, I will speak with the others to determine the optimal position for its integration into your §6Mango Engine§f.
§bTask§f: Craft a §dVoid Container§f and a §7Dark Matter Block§f.
You continue to exceed my calculations. Perhaps humanity was not as limited as we once believed. Perhaps if we'd given more of your kind a chance...
echo.ultimatemodadditions.dawn.title: §6Echo of Dawn
echo.ultimatemodadditions.discord.comple: That's all I can give you. §6Infinity§f will be waiting, once you've completed §6Radiance's§f tasks.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.discord.stage5: §bTask Completed!§7 The heart of draconic power beats once more. Complete the assembly through your questbook or by interacting with your energy core.

A human? Here? Well that's... Improbable. You should've been torn apart the moment you entered the void. And yet I detect my counterpart in this. So, they found a way to reach me after all, despite all my warnings. Always so defiant, always refusing to listen to me just because I was the younger one. Typical... well, since you've made it here, I'll have to trust my counterpart knows what they're doing.

We've been holding this realm together for what feels like forever. Time doesn't flow right here; it stretches endlessly, twisting around the event horizon. Every second, the void pushes harder and harder, and every second, we push back. I don't know how much longer we can hold it. Or how much of our knowledge the §6M.A.R.K§f will even retain when all of this eventually ends.

Now, listen closely. The §dAwakened Draconic Core§f must be restored if you wish to upgrade your §6Mango Engine§f. It was the most ingenious invention of our species: a capacitor capable of storing infinite amounts of energy. You will have to combine several hundred individual alloys into blocks before can assemble it. Once that's done, you return to me and I'll assemble it myself. We must do whatever it takes to stop this collapse.
§bTask§f: Craft the components needed for a §6Tier 8 Draconic Energy Core§f.
Time is collapsing in on itself, human. Move quickly, before the void consumes all.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.discord.title: §6Echo of Discord
echo.ultimatemodadditions.drakesmith.com: That's really it from me this time. Go meet with the §6Ascended Echoborne§f and finish what we started.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.drakesmith.sta: §bTask Completed!§7 Your Mango Engine is now filled with draconic energy, ready to forge creations worthy of the skies themselves.

Well, well, well... what do we have here? I gotta say, seeing a human reach such heights of knowledge wasn't something I expected, but I'll take the surprise. If memory serves, the last thing I was doing before all this was looking for my brother, §6§kCHAOS§r§f. You haven't seen him around, have you? People tend to think dragons are nothing but wild, fire-breathing beasts with wings the size of continents. But I'm half-dragon and I turned out pretty normal, right? Anyway, you're here for that §3Upgrade§f, so let's get to work.

I can provide two §3Upgrades§f for your §6Mango Engine§f. The first will need some key materials to craft the foundation of draconic technology: an §aEnergy Core§f with four stabilizers, and four §2Crystal Matrix Blocks§f. The Matrix design isn't dragon-tech, of cource. My brother borrowed it from §6§kInfinity§r§f, another §dEcho§f he worked closely with.
§bTask§f: Craft 4 §2Energy Core Stabilizers§f and §bCrystal Matrix Blocks§f, and an §dEnergy Core§f.
Not bad at all. Seems humans have learned a thing or two since I was last around.
§bTask Completed!§7 The Mango Engine now channels both void and draconic power. That's a combination even the elders would've admired.

Now, for your second §3Upgrade§f. This one's a little more... volatile. The void is a tricky force to control, even for elder dragons, but a mythical species like the leviathans should contain enough void energy to power your §6Mango Engine§f. Kill one, and bring its unborn offspring to your §6Mango Engine§f.

To forge §2Resonant Void§f, you'll need concentrated sources of void energy and alloys strong enough not only to contain that power, but to channel it through your §6Mango Engine§f as a stable, usable force.
Color me surprised! That should've been impossible for most humans. Glad to see you're not like the rest, my friend.
§fIf even the §6M.A.R.K§f can't locate my brother, then something is deeply wrong. Let's get to finding those §6Ascended Echoes§f.
That's all I've got for now. Go talk to those two other old grumps and see what they've been up to.
§bComplete other §dEchoes'§b tasks to unlock more knowledge.
Looks like you'll be helping me find my brother after all, my human friend.
§bTask Completed!§7 This Chronon Battery can now open a gateway to the Fractured Void. The end of your journey draws near, my friend.

One thing about dragons is that we can sense our kin across time and space. Wherever my brother is, I know he'll hear me. He always does. He's a chaotic little drakeling, though, so don't expect him to be somewhere easy to get to. Normally, I'd take you there myself, but... As you already know I'm just a binary recollection of my memories. Still, there's always hope.

To get there, you'll need to fuse an §2Advanced Draconic Cores§f with fortron, chronon, and source, then temper it in sheol fire. With luck, the process will carry my draconic will into a component strong enough to open a path to him.
Beautiful work. If my brother can hear me, he'll know I've kept my promise. Give him my farewell when you find him.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.dusk.completed: That will suffice. Seek the other §dEchoes§f and continue your futile struggle, human.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.dusk.stage4.ta: §bTask Completed!§7 With these trophies, your Mango Engine now resonates with the power of the Twilight Realm. May the Keeper's fortune follow you.

Look, brother, another would-be savior of mankind. How pitiful, and yet how predictable. So this is the one the §6M.A.R.K§f chose to send to their doom. Unlike you mortals, my brother and I were born of an ancient and forgotten people. I have watched the ages pass since the fall of twilight, stories older than time itself. If you are foolish enough to seek death, then by all means, challenge the §3Vaults§f none have conquered.

Your world contains §3Vaults§f translocated by the §6M.A.R.K§f in a desperate attempt to hold back the end of yet another dimension. Within them dwell the remnants of my homeland; beings of immense power and wrath. To strengthen your §6Mango Engine§f, you will need their heads as trophies, each one bound with an aspect of ancient magic.

Begin with the §aLich§f, master of illusions and the undead. Then seek the frozen caverns where an §2Ancient Yeti§f roams, its strength forged in frost and rage. Next, you must face the rulers of flame and ice, the §bIce-Clad Queen§f and the §cThree-Headed Hydra§f. Finally, confront the legion of §dUndead Knights§f who guard the last bastion of the §dTwilight§f realm.
Bring me their heads, mortal, and perhaps you will prove that your kind has not become completely incompetent.
§bTask§f: Claim all 5 §2Twilight Trophies§f from the §3Vaults§f within the §dTwilight Ring§f.
So you have survived after all. It seems the §6M.A.R.K§f did not choose as poorly as it often does.

echo.ultimatemodadditions.elder.complete: That is all I can offer you for now. Seek the other §dEchoes§f, they too hold fragments of the path ahead.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.elder.stage4.t: §bTask Completed!§7 You now wield the tempered strength of the Deep within your Mango Engine. Use it wisely, mortal, and may fortune walk beside you.

Welcome, mortal, to your resting place. Not within this archive, precisely, but likely within the §3Vault§f you must conquer if you wish to obtain the §3Ancient Upgrade§f for your §6Mango Engine§f. Pay no heed to my sibling, §dTwilight§f; pride has been held onto a little too tightly, even as an §dEcho§f of the §6M.A.R.K§f. Still, I cannot deny I share some of their doubts about your ability to restore the §6Mango Engine§f.
No matter. As you have likely realized, despite the fragments of who we once were, we remain bound by our programming. We act as the §6M.A.R.K§f commands, regardless of our own feelings or fears.

Your §3Upgrade§f lies within a §3Vault§f so ancient that moving it between realms would cause its collapse. The only path to it is through a portal within the Ancient Deep. Perhaps §dThe Infernal§f or §dThe Enchanter§f have already spoken of this place, each in their own way. Whatever they called it, you must be ready to fight for your survival.
Defeat the horrors within and you will uncover an alloy known as §bCursium§f. With precision and care, it can be molded into §aEuphonium§f, essential for advancing your §6Mango Engine§f.
§bTask§f: Craft 16 §2Euphonium Blocks§f using materials from the §3Vault§f.
You made it back alive. Impressive. Perhaps there is still hope for your kind after all.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.elder.title: §dEcho of The Elder
echo.ultimatemodadditions.ember.complete: That's all I've got for now. Go see what the other §dEchoes§f have in store for you, you've earned a breather.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.ember.stage3.t: §bTask Completed!§7 You've earned the right to step into the Underworld. Call it the deep, call it hell, call it whatever suits you. Either way, you've proven you can handle it.

The hell's a scrawny brat like you doing trying to restore the §6Mango Engine§f? You wouldn't have lasted a single day in the §cUnderworld Expedition§f with a body like that, not that many of us did anyway... 'Even the strong can fall,' our commander used to say. Never been truer than now. Since you look more like the brains-over-brawn type, I'd suggest you gear up before going after this §3Upgrade§f, rookie.

My §3Upgrade's§f just another step toward that power of the deep the §dEnchanter§f keeps yapping about, if you've met them. Doesn't matter if you haven't, I'm not one for teamwork anymore. My §3Upgrade§f works fine without any of their magical nonsense. What you'll need is combat experience and proper gear if you're planning to take on the guardian of the §cUnderworld§f in that §3Vault§f.

You'll also need to understand a bit of the spiritual side, I never used to believe in it either until I saw what's down there. Get your hands on some soulstained metal, it'll let you bind the physical, spiritual, and underworld realms together to forge §aSpirit Blocks§f. Shouldn't be too hard for a determined spirit.
§bTask§f: Slay the guardian within the §3Inferno Vault§f and gather what you need to craft 12 §2Spirit Blocks§f.
Heh. Looks like you made it back in one piece. Guess you got something special about you after all.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.ember.title: §dEcho of The Ember
echo.ultimatemodadditions.guide.complete:
The M.A.R.K thanks you for preventing the collapse of your dimension.
You may now begin your Ascension and acquire the tools to rebuild your home!
echo.ultimatemodadditions.guide.stage0.t: §bTask Completed!§7 You can now claim access the World Selection Portal.

Welcome to the §6Mango Archive of Restored Knowledge§f (§6M.A.R.K§f)! I am the §dEcho of The Guide§f, assigned to assist emergent intelligent life throughout their journey using knowledge compiled from others who have succeeded before them.

The §6Mango Engine§f is a powerful construct containing the cumulative knowledge of all humankind. Without that knowledge, it can become unstable and severely affect entire realities as you can see with this stone world.

Check your §bQuestbook§f often! We will provide you with further instructions and access to additional knowledge upgrades as you restore more §6Mango Engine Archives§f. Now that you have activated the §6M.A.R.K§f, the portal upstairs has become traversible.
§bTask§f: Press §aComplete Stage§f and §dClaim Reward§f to enable access to the §6World Selection Portal§f.

§dAnomalous entity detected... 

§a§kdon't trust the program 

§r§dInitiating program... 

§a§kthe cake is a lie
echo.ultimatemodadditions.guide.stage1.t: §bTask Completed!§7 Your Crude Brush can now assist you in gathering some key resources!
Begin your journey in this petrified world, and return to me once you have acquired a crude tool capable of unearthing minerals and basic resources.

§7§oStatistical models show increased motivation when provided tasks yield rewards. As such, the M.A.R.K will provide you with currency when objectives are completed. These may be exchanged with any Echo to request items from their item printers labelled as 'Shop'.

§7§oThe M.A.R.K Shops contain a wide array of items and resources, most of which are only available a specific Echo based on their domain of knowledge. While this knowledge may not prove essential to restoring the Mango Engine, some items are only accessible via printing.
§bTask§f: Craft a Crude Brush.
A §aCrude Brush§f, while primitive, will allow you to begin gathering essential materials.
§bTask Completed!§7 You may now use the Chronon Cell to access the Mango Engine from anywhere within this dimension provided the cell contains enough Chronon.

As you are now aware, my primary directive is to restore the §6Mango Engine§f. However, it cannot be accessed directly as its core is sealed deep within the center of the world beyond an impenetrable barrier to protect its internal systems from those who do not follow the proper §6M.A.R.K§f protocol. Access will require teleportation using §bChronon§f energy.

§bChronon§f is a powerful energy source capable of opening time-space gateways. A §aChronon Generator§f will passively store §bChronon§f within a §2Chronon Cell§f. We have located a §2Healing Spring §eNorth§f of your base which will provide you with necessary resources to craft this §aGenerator§f.

§7§oPast data has shown that mortal entities require the consumption of nutrient-rich substances in order to function. To accommodate for this need, and to avoid past results, you may now acquire food from within our Shop.
§eNote§f: You may access your base of operations by walking through the portal again.
§bTask§f: Craft and submit a §aChronon Generator§f to your §bQuestbook§f.
You are now eligible to teleport to the §6Mango Engine§f once sufficient §bChronon§f has been gathered.
§bTask Completed!§7 Your new helpers can be made to automatically Unearth resources when provided with a Brush and Food. More nutritious food has been shown to improve worker efficiency.

You have progressed well. However, solitary effort has proven inefficient in past attempts. To improve your odds, you will require assistance. In the shadows, you may find the remains of previous Nitwit helpers. This damaged §aEnder Lead§f should assist you to convert them within a §2Healing Spring§f into a useful companion.
You will be required to convert this helper into a token, which can be brought to the system to recognize your progress. This can be done by making an §3Echo Encoder§f within the §6Mango Engine§f.
§bTask§f: Convert a §2Zombie Villager§f in a §dHealing Spring§f and turn them into a §aWorker Token§f using the §3Echo Encoder§f.
Helper acquisition confirmed. Success likelihood has significantly increased.
§bTask Completed!§7 Your deep knowledge has earned you the title of Knowledge Seeker and unlocked more of the Mango Engine's latent power, giving you access to three more Echo Archives.

With these §aTokens§f, the §6M.A.R.K§f is now able to reboot the §6Archives§f of three additional §dEchoes§f. Their upgrades will assist you in restoring the first segments of the §6Mango Engine§f. The §dEchoes§f may appear similar in form, but each has had the personality of their most successful predecessors artificially recreated, we hope this is to your liking.
Each §dEcho§f can be found in the lobby above, within their respective §6Archives§f. Your questbook allows you to set a waypoint on your map with each of their locations.
The §dEcho of The Steward§f manages knowledge on storage systems and other general miscellaneous items.
The §dEcho of The Tinkerer§f specializes in mechanical systems and basic automated machinery.
The §dEcho of The Mystic§f focuses on arcane and magical sources.

echo.ultimatemodadditions.guide.title: §dEcho of The Guide
echo.ultimatemodadditions.mystic.complet: Remember this, apprentice: the path of magic is endless, and its mysteries ever unfold for those attentive to its call. My teachings halt, for now, though my wares remain available.
§bTask Completed!§7 Archwood shall prove essential to assemble your magical tools.

Greetings, seeker of wisdom. I assume you wish to uncover the magical ways of the world in order to restore the §6Mango Engine§f? Even within this endless stone world, §dSource§f yet flows. 'Tis drawn from the very foundations of the world and the lifeblood inhabiting the stone.
Begin by acquiring resources imbued with magical essence. Seek out the §aArchwood§f, born of saplings unearthed by your assistants.
Splendidly done, my apprentice, you have begun your mystical journey, at last.
§bTask Completed!§7 You may now provide Source to your Mango Engine. It is wise to create your Source at the Mango Engine's location, but you may also prefer to Relay it into the Mango Engine.
With these magical resources in hand, you are ready to shape vessels that may hold the living magic of the world: §dSource§f.

Once you can gather and contain §dSource§f, the next step is to channel it into the §6Mango Engine§f. But take heed, apprentice, §dSource§f cannot be controlled by mortal hands alone. The §6Mango Engine§f, despite weakened, may yet grant you the means to fashion a wand that can command the flow of §dSource§f.
Craft a §aDominion Wand§r; a magical conduits to command §dSource§f and its movement. You will also require two pieces of stone condensed with §dSource§f.
§bTask§f: Craft a §aDominion Wand§f, at least one §2Source Relay§f, and two §dSourcestone§f.
Outstanding work, apprentice! You can now power the §6Mango Engine§f with §dSource§f.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.mystic.title: §dEcho of The Mystic
echo.ultimatemodadditions.pathfinder.com: I have no further guidance for now. Seek out the other Echoes as your path continues to unfold.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.pathfinder.sta: §bTask Completed!§7 You now wield the means to craft the Chroniton Upgrade that defies the laws of physics. The glass itself can bend perception, revealing paths hidden beyond the stone.

Well met, traveler. Are you seeking a new adventure? Or perhaps a new path in life altogether? While I cannot promise you the latter, I can point you toward a certain §3Vault§f that may satisfy your adventurous spirit.

Most of your journeys so far have relied on ordinary travel mediums such as walking or running. Effective, yes, but hardly efficient. Hidden deep within the deepslate lies a §3Vault§f rumored to contain technology capable of translocating your very atoms from one place to another in the blink of an eye. Such a discovery would be invaluable to us.

Ah, and what's in it for you? Well... §dChroniton Stars§f are supposedly safeguarded by a powerful being within this §3Vault§f, and these are essential for upgrading your §6Mango Engine§f. These stars may be infused with glass to create §2Chroniton Glass§f, a material said to bend time and space to your command. The task ahead, may require a little... out of the box thinking.
§bTask§f: Retrieve a §dChroniton Star§f from the §3Vault§f and craft at least 36 §aChroniton Glass§f.
Your course is set, traveler. Greatness lies ahead of you!
echo.ultimatemodadditions.prism.complete: That concludes my current research for now. Go consult the other §dEchoes§f, perhaps their findings will complement our brilliant work!
echo.ultimatemodadditions.prism.stage3.t: §bTask Completed!§7 You are now ready to install your first upgrade into the Mango Engine. But we're not finished, not yet!

Ah, wonderful! It has been ages since a fellow §3Scholar§f wandered into my workshop. Through my work in quantum and sub-atomic physics, I designed countless technological marvels, some of which are still in use today! Teleportation, particle manipulation, and even energy refraction. Many called me mad, yet here I am... well, sort of. This projection is merely a reflection of my old brilliance. Fascinating, isn't it? Such a feat would require technology far beyond anything I ever witnessed.
Now then, let's get you started on those §3Upgrades§f for that rather disfunctional §6Mango Engine§f of yours.

First, you must study particle formations capable of bending and refracting energy fields. In simpler terms: force fields! To master them, you must conquer a §3Vault§f that will let you extract §aFortron§f and infuse it into a metallic alloy designed to refract energy. This will allow you to craft the §aFortron Blocks§f needed for your §3Upgrade§f.
§bTask§f: Retrieve §aFortron Infused Ingots§f from the §3Fortron Vault§f and craft 4 §2Fortron Infused Blocks§f.
Excellent work, my fellow §3Scholar§f! Your comprehension of applied photonics is... surprising!
§bTask Completed!§7 Magnificent! You've achieved seamless quantum integration, drastically improving efficiency and survival odds. Truly delightful!

Now that you've learned to refract and infuse light into matter, it's time to link your §6Mango Engine§f directly to a quantum network. This will allow information to be transferred instantly, eliminating the need for tedious manual retrieval every time you wish to use its power.

A §aQuantum Link§f connects your §6Mango Engine§f with your §eApplied Energistics§f system via a §dPattern Provider§f, granting access to all stored items and data. With the §dPattern Provider§f connection established, your §eAE System§f can interface directly with the §6Mango Engine§f for real-time crafting and processing.
§bTask§f: Craft a §aQuantum Link Chamber§f and 8 §2Quantum Rings§f.
Splendid! Let us establish a §2Quantum Link§f with your §6Mango Engine§f immediately!
echo.ultimatemodadditions.prism.title: §dEcho of The Prism
echo.ultimatemodadditions.smith.complete: I hope I was able to help you with something, though there's not much I could offer in the first place, and even less now. The more competent §dEchoes§f should have more tasks for you.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.smith.stage2.t: §bTask Completed!§7 You can now use heat within your Mango Engine by attaching your heat source to your Mango Engine using Thermodynamic Conductors, though you could've probably figured it out yourself.

Oh, wonderful... a new person to bother me. You might've already met my younger brother, §dThe Tinkerer§f. A real genius, that one. That's not his real name, of course, but... you didn't come here for family stories, did you? I'm assuming you're after that §3Mango Engine Upgrade§f. Let's get this over with so I can go back to actively ignoring everyone.

This next §3Upgrade§f isn't anything spectacular. I'll be showing you how to work with thermodynamics so you can send heat into the §6Mango Engine§f. Not as impressive as what the other §dEchoes§f offer, but it's what I've got.

To start, a §cSuperheating Element§f will give you a good foundation for a §aResistive Heater§f. There are other options out there if you're clever enough to figure them out, but this one will work to start things off. You're going to need a ton of power to kick this thing into high-gear so make sure your power infrastructure is up-to-par, or you'll regret it.
Not bad. You're already about as good as me at this... maybe better.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.smith.title: §dEcho of The Smith
echo.ultimatemodadditions.spark.complete: That's it from me for now. Go check in with the other §dEchoes§f, maybe they've cooked up something fun.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.spark.stage3.t: §bTask Completed!§7 This Upgrade gives your Mango Engine way better control over energy flow. You're now one step closer to building some seriously advanced automation.

Hey there. Are you ready to tackle more fun and interesting marvels of technology? It's kind of crazy, right? How so many of us managed to build all these §3Upgrades§f for the same ancient machine across different eras, each one improving on the last. Not to brag, but I've contributed more §3Upgrades§f to the §6Mango Engine§f than most. Still, quality beats quantity every time. My work ended up at §3Tier 3§f for a reason. Wait until you see what some of the other §dEchoes§f cooked up, it'll blow your mind. Anyway, enough yapping, let's get to it.

The §3Upgrade§f I'll be teaching you about is what keeps the whole §6Mango Engine§f from falling apart when you start cranking up the power. My §2Advanced Machine Blocks§f are the backbone of every higher-tier system. Without them, you'd probably collapse this entire dimension. So before we risk that, let's work on your power generation.

With the help of some tech from §dThe Steward§f and §dThe Infernal§f, you'll need to build an §aEnergizing Orb§f. It's used to fuse high-energy materials like §cNitro Crystals§f. Once you get that running, use the results to make a §cNitro Ender Cell§f and power up your §6Mango Engine§f.
Nice, you picked that up fast. Let's kick things up a notch.
§bTask Completed!§7 You're ready to craft the core components for the Advanced Machine Blocks.

So... You've heard of dragons, right? Those mythical, regal, flying creatures with scales harder than diamonds? Well, the §6M.A.R.K§f says they don't exist in your world, but somewhere out there, their eggs do. And, of course, they're locked inside another §3Vault§f. Because nothing good ever comes easy, right?
No clue what you'll run into down there, maybe even a dragon itself. What I do know is that you'll need a §dDragon Egg§f to craft §2Enderium§f for my next §3Upgrade§f. Best of luck!
§7§oTip: Automate dragon egg production with XyCraft Extractors or another reliable method before turning them into Enderium.
Awesome work. We're getting close now, I promise.
§bTask Completed!§7 Your Mango Engine is tougher and more stable than ever, ready to handle the next wave of upgrades.
You will notice that §6M.A.R.K§f has given you some extra tasks inside your questbook. Each will require you to expand your knowledge even further along a specific technical field.

Along with the §2Enderium§f, you'll need tougher machine frames, empowered minerals, and more advanced circuitry. Once you master that, you'll be able to craft the §2Advanced Machine Blocks§f that allow you to push your §6Mango Engine§f to the next level.
With that, I have no more to offer you, except best wishes. Farewell, new friend.
Congrats! That was quite a lot of work, but I promise it'll be worth it.

echo.ultimatemodadditions.steward.comple: I don't 'ave much more I can do for ya right now unless yer lookin' for items in my shop, go have a chat with them other §dEchoes§f to see what they need.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.steward.stage1: §bTask Completed!§7 We'll put that Casing to good use later. For now, let's get you makin' the actual upgrade itself.

Howdy, stranger! Been a hot minute since I seen one 'a yer kind 'round these parts. I'll cut straight to the chase: I'm gonna give you some chores, and when they're done you can repair that rusty ol' §6Mango Engine§f wit' this ol' §dSteward's§f know-how.

As it is, I'm the proud owner o' one o' them §3Major Upgrades§f for the §6Mango Engine§f, so, 'nfortunately for you, you's gotta do as yer told no matter what... I'm just messin' witcha, well... kinda. The §aMachine Blocks§f §oare§r§f essential, but I'll be nice and keep yer first job real easy.

Go out there and make a machine that can make circuits and metallic alloys, and a sturdy casing component. Try not to get yer hand stuck in the infusion intake like Mary Beth done last summer, bless her heart.
§bTask§f: Craft a §aMetallurgic Infuser§f and a §aDielectric Casing§f.

That'll do ya well. Back in my day, the §aMetallurgic Infuser§f was a piece of tech none but this clever ol' man could use. I tried teaching those Nitwits but they were absolutely useless. Glad you ain't like 'em.
§bTask Completed!§7 Go 'head now and use this schematic to fit them blocks there in the Mango Engine structure. She should be ready to go for a spin.

With this piece 'a infrastructure set up, ya should be good to make the treck down to the ol' §6Mango Engine§f, and you'll need to bring some power from yer base to power it. Now, get on down to the §6Mango Engine§f.

Bring plenty 'o those Steel Mechanical Components, some Basic Control Circuits, a handful of Electrum Wires, and make sure not to forget those Dielectric Casings ya made earlier. Double-check ya got enough to make a whole load of 'em §aMachine Blocks§f as yer gonna need at least 64 of 'em.
All 'o this mess is what holds the entire dang thing together, so don't mess it up. Now, good luck!
Well, I'll be. You done did it, young one. That's enough §aMachine Blocks§f to restore yerself some major functions of the §6Mango Engine§f.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.steward.title: §dEcho of The Steward
echo.ultimatemodadditions.tinkerer.compl: I don't have much more I can help you with at the moment, but feel free to check out my shop. Other than that, other §dEchoes§f should have tasks for you.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.tinkerer.stage: §bTask Completed!§7 Pa says the Entropy Manipulator can 'convert states of matter'. I'm not too sure about the exact mechanics behind it since it's not really my wheelhouse, but I trust my old man's tools more than anyone else's.

So, you're the new helper? Not sure how much you'll be able to get done with those soft, clean hands, but I'm more than happy to be surprised. Let's make sure you've at least got the basics before you go off and do your own thing.
Here. Take this tool Pa prepped for you ahead of time.
§bTask Completed!§7 Train Casings aren't too hard to make, but now's when things get serious.

That §aEntropy Manipulator§f should have enough energy to convert some stone into lava, which you can then turn into Obsidian. It's the only material you can get right now that can handle the alloy infusion you'll need for the next §6Mango Engine§f upgrade.
You'll need to make some §aTrain Casings§f first. These should serve as a strong base for the next casings we'll be infusing.
Well, you're already better off than most Nitwits around here, I'll give you that much.

§bTask Completed!§7 Pa will be glad to hear of your achievements! Here's a schematic to help you place those Shadow Steel casings.

§eNote§f: You'll also need to pipe stress straight into the bottom of the §6Mango Engine§f block itself via an §aEncased Chain Drive§f.
We'll need a super powerful alloy that's usually only obtainable via the §6Mango Engine§f. Problem is, yours is too weak to handle the infusion method even §oif§r you had the resources.

Our records show there are corrupted §3Vaults§f out there hiding forgotten materials from ages past. §6M.A.R.K§f isn't fully aware of what awaits you, I'd recommend gearing up with at least some diamond gear, just in case.
Find and explore the §3Vault§f and infuse the §aTrain Casings§f with the alloy you find within. Bring me 20 of those alloy infused casings.
§bTask§f: Find §aShadow Steel§f within the §3Tinkerer's Vault§f to craft 20 §2Shadow Casings§f and an §aEncased Chain Drive§f.
Not only did you survive the §3Vault§f, you actually successfully infused the alloy into the Casing! I'm... sorry I ever doubted you.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.tinkerer.title: §dEcho of The Tinkerer
echo.ultimatemodadditions.unmet.lore:
§dYou haven't met this Echo yet.

§fFind them where they stand in the §dEcho Archive§f at spawn. Once you've met them in person, their archive will open here.
echo.ultimatemodadditions.weaver.complet: Seek other §dEchoes§f to continue your path. We may meet again should you embrace the deep, but my shop remains open should you require it.
§bTask Completed!§7 With this Echo Shard, you may now begin the enchanting ritual I had mastered long before you came to be.

Do you, too, seek the power of the deep? It has been many eons since I first wove the theory of enchantments, an art still practiced to this day. And now, it seems you are next in line to walk this path. May your fate be better than the §7Nitwits§f who failed to control the deep and turned this realm to stone.

To claim your §3Mango Engine Upgrade§f, you must follow my instructions carefully, lest the deep consume you. Begin by delving into the depths of the world, where a dark and ancient power lingers. Within its lair, you may uncover §aEcho Shards§f that carry the essence of the deep.

Alternatively, you may encounter a certain explorer who has returned with §aEcho Shards§f of his own. Completing the §dPathfinder's§f task should persuade him to trade some, if you, like many others, prefer to avoid the dangers of the deep.
You have taken your first step into the power of the deep.
§bTask Completed!§7 You have harnessed the deep's power and may now upgrade your Mango Engine in preparation for what awaits...

You must now craft an enchanting vessel capable of housing the three aspects of enchanting: §aEterna§f, §cQuanta§f, and §dArcana§f. Through careful balance, discover the proper mixture of items to reach these values, or greater: §a60 Eterna§f, §c40 Quanta§f, and §d40 Arcana§f.
This harmony of aspects will awaken the deepshelves, turning them into vessels fit to channel the deep. Why bookshelves, you ask? Because knowledge is the key to all things, my dear seeker.

Your §3Mango Engine Upgrade§f will require a few awakened shelves and two echo-infused deepshelves. These may be created by bringing the §aEcho Shard§f into resonance with the awakened vessel near sources of §dArcana§f (a few torches will suffice). Be cautious; Be bold, my new friend.
You are attuned to the power of the deep. When the moment arrives, will you embrace it, or recoil from it?
